parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Name three types of writings found in the Bible.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Briefly describe how the Bible is used in church services.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why the Bible is a source of authority for Christians.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Reading the Bible is more important than going to church.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
‘I am the Lord your God who brought you out of slavery and out of Egypt. You
shall have no other Gods before me.’
Exodus 20:2–3

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Name three things Christians believe in, according to the Apostles’ Creed.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Outline the birth story of Jesus.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the importance of the resurrection of Jesus for Christians.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The Ten Commandments are the most important Christian text.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section, answer all the questions.
3 (a) (i) What is the relationship between the minaret and the adhan (call to prayer)?

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Briefly describe how Jummah (Friday mid-day) prayers are different from other
prayers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the significance of the muezzin for Muslims.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Ordinary people can easily follow the example of the Prophet (pbuh).’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer. 
‘You who believe, fasting is prescribed for you, as it was for those before you,
so that you will become mindful of Allah.’
Surah 2:183

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Give three things Muslims should avoid during sawm.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Briefly describe what is meant by the hajj.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why a Muslim might choose to use prayer beads.

‘The persecution of the early Muslims in Makkah is still relevant today.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

‘Only rabbis need to study the Talmud (commentary).’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer. 
‘Every day I will praise your name, and exalt you for ever and ever.’
Psalm 145:2
